criterion: Peer-reviewed journal article published 2025-2026, in English
Journal of an established publisher indexed in Scopus/WoS/IEEE Xplore/PubMed
Primary empirical study proposing and evaluating a security/privacy mechanism
In scope: IoMT/healthcare-IoT/WBAN intrusion or anomaly detection; medical image security; federated healthcare security; blockchain healthcare IoT
Reports a described method and at least one quantitative result
Review, survey, systematic review, bibliometric study, taxonomy, tutorial, roadmap or comparison-only study
Non-peer-reviewed: preprint (arXiv, Preprints.org, Research Square, TechRxiv, SSRN), Zenodo self-archive, thesis, technical report
Venue not indexed in Scopus/WoS/IEEE Xplore/PubMed or predatory-risk publisher
Outside the healthcare/medical context, or no security/privacy/detection objective
No retrievable abstract; eligibility cannot be assessed
Position paper, editorial, commentary, teaching case or dataset-only paper
Quality-appraisal score >= 75 / 100 on the ten-item NIH/Zeng-derived rubric
